scope: layer4 gradients plus FC baseline at the same original model
loss: Mean cross-entropy of each entire private R/F subset, evaluated at the original checkpoint
classifier_logits: Double precision to match previous FC analytic calculation
primary_metrics: Direct difference norm and channel-energy Gini
causal_limitation: Removing anchors, clipping and 100-step accumulation together does not isolate the causal effect of KL alone.
